subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

There was a story about a kind tree and a little boy. He used to sit ______ the shade of the tree.
solution:
The correct answer is** "in". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In this context, the use of the preposition** "in" **must be appropriate.
 
• The correct preposition to use with **"shade"** is **"in." **
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase is **"in the shade."**
